changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO stretchy_report_parameter (report_id, parameter_id, report_parameter_name) SELECT sr.id, sp.id, 'groupId' FROM stretchy_report sr CROSS JOIN stretchy_parameter sp WHERE sr.report_name IN ('GroupSummaryCounts', 'GroupSummaryAmounts') AND sp.parameter_variable = 'groupId' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stretchy_report_parameter existing WHERE existing.report_id = sr.id AND existing.parameter_id = sp.id );
